nodes.rationale: Whole machinery lives in one module — any model with a followers M2M is followable; no per-app notification code beyond call sites

nodes.label: Django-Q2 async task execution
nodes.rationale: Delivery never runs inline in the request; Q_SYNC defaults True in dev so tasks execute synchronously for debuggability

nodes.label: /protected_media/ streaming route
nodes.rationale: Media is never served directly by the web server — both prefixes are Django routes so authentication applies; LoginRequiredMiddleware is the actual security boundary

nodes.label: Env-driven OAuth provider configuration
nodes.rationale: No SocialApp DB rows by design: fail-fast at startup when env vars are missing, at the cost of requiring a process restart to change providers

nodes.label: FEATURES_FLAGS global defaults
nodes.rationale: No flag service and no database table: flags are plain booleans with a global default, env override, and optional per-family override reusing TenantSettings.overrides

nodes.label: GEDCOM all-or-nothing idempotent import
nodes.rationale: parse() runs inside transaction.atomic and uses update_or_create on gedcom_id, so re-importing the same file updates rather than duplicates and never leaves a partial import

nodes.label: GEDCOM charset transcoding (_ensure_utf8)
nodes.rationale: python-gedcom hardcodes UTF-8, so the CHAR tag is mapped (ANSEL/ANSI to latin-1, UNICODE to utf-16, IBMPC to cp437, WINDOWS-1252 to cp1252) with errors=replace to avoid hard failure

nodes.label: Session invitation triple (token, email, tenant_id)
nodes.rationale: Stored when the invitee opens the email link, validated and popped by the social adapter — the invitation is single-use

nodes.label: NotificationEvent batch emails
nodes.rationale: Batched events are consumed (deleted) after the summary mail is sent, not marked read

nodes.label: CustomSocialAccountAdapter invitation gate
nodes.rationale: Invariant: no invitation, no account — social login can never create or activate an uninvited account, and the invitation's tenant is the only source of truth for where an anonymous social signup lands

nodes.label: PostgreSQL RLS backstop
nodes.rationale: Neither isolation layer alone is trusted: ORM scoping is bypassable by a forgotten unscoped call, RLS is bypassable by the table owner — hence both

nodes.label: Public media directory convention (media/public/)
nodes.rationale: The whole public mechanism is a directory convention, not a storage routing decision — download_public_media re-prefixes Path('public') under MEDIA_ROOT

nodes.label: RegistrationLinkManager signed links
nodes.rationale: Payload '<tenant_id>:<email>' is tenant-prefixed so the target tenant is covered by the HMAC and cannot be swapped in the URL

nodes.label: TenantModel ORM scoping
nodes.rationale: Shared-schema multi-tenancy chosen over schema-per-tenant or database-per-tenant to get real isolation without operational cost

nodes.label: TenantSettings.overrides per-tenant settings
nodes.rationale: TENANT_SETTINGS_SPEC is an allow-list: only its keys are ever read per tenant, falling back override then global Django setting then default

nodes.label: theme.css public stylesheet
nodes.rationale: Look-and-feel customization is a single global stylesheet served anonymously from public storage so unauthenticated page loads can fetch it

nodes.label: Trove ownership-based publication rules
nodes.rationale: No publish/private flag exists: visibility is platform-wide for logged-in members and the only access rule is ownership (owner, tenant admin or superuser) — simplicity chosen over per-treasure privacy

nodes.label: Zip import Django-Q pipeline with HTMX progress
nodes.norm_label: zip import django-q pipeline with htmx progress
nodes.rationale: The upload request only schedules work; photos are created by per-image Django-Q tasks and the user watches an HTMX polling progress bar

nodes.label: Chat tables missing from TENANT_RLS_TABLES
nodes.rationale: ChatRoom and ChatMessage are TenantModel-scoped but get no row-level-security backstop because TENANT_RLS_TABLES still lists only members_member and the galleries tables; the tenants/rls.py comment listing chat as 'to convert' is stale

nodes.label: Bulk upload invalid-form TypeError bug
nodes.rationale: ": ".join(code, error) calls str.join with two arguments, so any invalid bulk-import form raises TypeError and yields HTTP 500 instead of field errors; fixing that one line is the whole fix

nodes.label: public storage alias replaced when MEDIA_STORAGE set
nodes.norm_label: public storage alias replaced when media_storage set
nodes.rationale: Setting MEDIA_STORAGE replaces the 'public' STORAGES alias wholesale while nothing selects storage='public', so the remote backend is inert; suspected misplaced-key bug vs operator expectation that MEDIA_STORAGE configures 'default'

nodes.label: Per-process tenant flags cache stale across workers
nodes.norm_label: per-process tenant flags cache stale across workers
nodes.rationale: clear_flags_cache() has a single caller (family-settings save) and _tenant_flags_cache is a per-process dict keyed without overrides content, so other worker processes serve stale flags until restart

nodes.label: Trove size limits unenforced
nodes.rationale: TROVE_FILE_MAX_SIZE and TROVE_PICTURE_FILE_MAX_SIZE have no consumer in any upload path; TROVE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_SIZE is enforced client-side only via summernote maxsize

nodes.label: ZIP_IMPORTS per-process progress state
nodes.rationale: Module-level dict holds in-flight ZipImport objects, so multi-worker deployments or mid-upload restarts make the progress poll 404 — in-memory state was chosen over shared storage for simplicity

nodes.label: ASGI Channels Websockets
nodes.rationale: ProtocolTypeRouter routes HTTP to the ASGI app and websockets to AuthMiddlewareStack(URLRouter(chat.routing.websocket_urlpatterns)); channel-layer socket_timeout is deliberately None to avoid racing channels-redis BZPOPMIN.

nodes.label: Classified Ads Contact Relay
nodes.rationale: No pre-publication moderation: an ad is visible as soon as it is created and status transitions are admin-only; owner contact is mediated by an email relay so the owner's address is never exposed, and send failures raise (fail_silently=False) rather than pretending success.

nodes.label: Custom User Model Member
nodes.rationale: AUTH_USER_MODEL = members.Member; reusable code must resolve get_user_model() instead of importing Member directly.

nodes.label: Django-Q2 Async Tasks
nodes.rationale: Q_SYNC defaults to True in development so async tasks execute synchronously and can be debugged/tested without a broker round-trip; qcluster runs as its own container in production.

nodes.label: ENVIRONMENT Settings Selection
nodes.rationale: core/settings.py dispatches on the ENVIRONMENT env var (default production) and raises ValueError for unknown values, so a mis-set environment fails fast instead of silently using production settings.

nodes.label: Followers Machinery
nodes.rationale: Apps call shared core.followers utilities (toggle_follow, check_followers, do_check_followers, generate_emails), optionally via a Django-Q2 task, instead of reimplementing notification fan-out; recipients come from followed_object.followers by convention.

nodes.label: GEDCOM Import Export
nodes.rationale: Import transcodes encodings to UTF-8 before parsing and update_or_creates persons on gedcom_id so re-imports update rather than duplicate; approximate GEDCOM dates degrade to a fallback year instead of failing.

nodes.label: LoginRequiredMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Every URL requires login except LOGIN_REQUIRED_IGNORE_PATHS so allauth/OAuth callbacks stay reachable while anonymous.

nodes.label: Member Invitation And Registration Links
nodes.rationale: One-time links are signed with salted_hmac over SECRET_KEY and the payload carries the tenant id, so the tenant covered by the HMAC cannot be swapped in the URL; no invitation means no signup.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy
nodes.rationale: Shared-schema multi-tenancy: every tenant-scoped row carries a tenant FK, isolation enforced first by tenant-scoped ORM managers and backstopped by PostgreSQL row-level security.

nodes.label: OKF Documentation Bundle
nodes.rationale: One fiche per app, module, flow, spec or plan, read by developers and AI agents before touching the code; all fiches stay status draft until reviewed and check_okf enforces frontmatter and staleness.

nodes.label: Predefined Pages Import
nodes.rationale: The updated flag protects UI edits: pages edited in the CMS are skipped on fixture re-import so hand-written content wins over stock pages.

nodes.label: Protected Media
nodes.rationale: Media is never served by the web server directly; it streams through an access-controlled view in 64 KB chunks with a blake2b If-None-Match ETag built from username and media path.

nodes.label: Chat Read Receipts
nodes.rationale: read_by bulk inserts use ignore_conflicts=True so concurrent readers race safely, and one grouped read_status_update is emitted so the sender's checkmark flips to a double check.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security Hardening
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth behind the ORM layer: strict FOR ALL policies for gallery tables, split policy (permissive SELECT, hard-scoped writes) for members; table owner always bypasses so policies are never FORCED.

nodes.label: Services Pattern
nodes.rationale: Views stay thin; business logic goes in <app>/services.py (or services/ package) so it is testable and reusable outside the request cycle.

nodes.label: TenantModel
nodes.rationale: Abstract base for scoped models: non-editable tenant FK, scoped objects manager, unscoped escape hatch, ensure_tenant() auto-assignment on save.

nodes.label: Tenant-Prefixed Channel Group Names
nodes.rationale: Slugs are only unique per tenant, so without the chat_<tenant_id>_<room_slug> prefix two families' rooms with the same slug would broadcast into each other.

nodes.label: transaction.atomic Write Discipline
nodes.rationale: Multi-write flows (message+post, photo+thumbnail, poll+question, tenant+settings) are wrapped in transaction.atomic so a failure never leaves half-written rows or orphaned files.

nodes.norm_label: f3 tooltip and read-only info-form injection mechanism
nodes.rationale: Design intent documented in family_chart.html comments: the f3 edit/info form is fully rebuilt on each open/toggle, so extra read-only info (places, age, parents, children, marriages) must be re-injected via setOnFormCreation on every render. form_creator only exposes datum_id (not the full datum), so the datum is resolved through f3Chart.store.getDatum with a dataById map as fallback. nodes.rationale: Requires typing the family slug to confirm because deletion is permanent and removes ALL family data (members, galleries, photos); delete button only exposed for deactivated, non-system tenants.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security Backstop
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth: the database itself refuses cross-tenant writes; migration tenants.0003_rls creates a DML-only runtime role (POSTGRES_RUNTIME_USER) while migrations run as owner; middleware sets app.current_tenant_id per request and always resets it so pooled connections never leak a tenant; members_member reads stay permissive because login by email happens before the tenant is known; platform superusers get app.bypass for cross-tenant administration.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy (Several Families per Deployment)
nodes.rationale: Off by default so a single-family deployment behaves exactly like the classic app; isolation uses a tenant-scoped ORM manager (TenantManager) plus TenantMiddleware as the primary layer, with tenants.Tenant (name, slug, is_active), Member.role='admin' family admins, is_superuser platform admins on the seeded, undeletable 'system' and 'default' tenants; emails are routed to the family's admin.

nodes.label: Database & Redis Settings (POSTGRES_*, REDIS_HOST)
nodes.rationale: POSTGRES_PASSWORD is auto-generated by manage_cousins_matter.py on install/migrate; if changed manually it must avoid ':' and '@' because those characters break the connection URL parsing.

nodes.label: .env Configuration File
nodes.rationale: All Cousins Matter settings are managed through a single .env file in the application's main directory; an example .env is downloaded automatically by manage_cousins_matter.py (or copied from .env.example when working from source). Changes only take effect after 'docker compose restart' — the running container does not hot-reload .env.

nodes.label: FEATURES_FLAGS Feature Flag Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Features offered to members are toggled by one semicolon-separated FEATURES_FLAGS variable that must stay on a single line in .env; any flag absent from the list is considered false. Design migration: the old INCLUDE_BIRTHDAYS_IN_HOMEPAGE variable was replaced by the show_birthdays_in_homepage feature flag to unify per-feature toggles.

nodes.label: Gallery Settings (Page Size, File Sizes, Slideshow Delay)
nodes.norm_label: gallery settings (page size, file sizes, slideshow delay)

nodes.label: Login History Settings (Geolocation Placeholder IP, Purge Days)
nodes.norm_label: login history settings (geolocation placeholder ip, purge days)
nodes.rationale: LOGIN_HISTORY_GEOLOCATION_PLACEHOLDER_IP lets the administrator declare the server's external IP so geolocation of internal-network logins still resolves; history is retained for LOGIN_HISTORY_PURGE_DAYS (default 365) and visible to administrators in Django admin.

nodes.label: Member Management Permissions (ALLOW_MEMBERS_TO_CREATE/INVITE)
nodes.rationale: Setting ALLOW_MEMBERS_TO_CREATE_MEMBERS or ALLOW_MEMBERS_TO_INVITE_MEMBERS to False restricts member creation/invitation to admins only — a site-level governance choice, defaulting to open (True).

nodes.label: Network Setup (ALLOWED_HOSTS, CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS)
nodes.rationale: ALLOWED_HOSTS must contain the full production site URL (and sometimes the site IP). A 'Forbidden (Origin checking failed)' login error is fixed by setting CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the full domain(s) using .env syntax, not the Python syntax shown in the error; CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS is derived from CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

nodes.label: OAuth/SSO Provider Configuration
nodes.rationale: OAuth is opt-in: OAUTH_PROVIDERS is empty by default; enabling a provider requires <PROVIDER>_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and <PROVIDER>_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (plus <PROVIDER>_SERVER_URL for OpenID Connect providers such as PocketID). SOCIALACCOUNT_AUTO_SIGNUP controls whether OAuth logins require confirmation (default: confirmation required).

nodes.label: SECRET_KEY & Secret Rotation
nodes.rationale: SECRET_KEY protects the site and must be kept secret; PREVIOUS_SECRET_KEYS retains old keys so tokens already sent to members with a previous key can still be decoded, which is why rotation is done via the rotate-secrets command rather than by hand-editing the value.

nodes.label: Site Identity Settings (SITE_NAME, SITE_LOGO, DARK_MODE)
nodes.rationale: SITE_LOGO must be stored in the site's media/public folder and its URL must start with '/media/public' because only that tree is served publicly; the logo requires a 4:1 ratio.

nodes.label: Superuser Creation Env Vars
nodes.rationale: ADMIN, ADMIN_PASSWORD, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_FIRSTNAME and ADMIN_LASTNAME are all mandatory with no defaults and must be provided before the first 'docker compose up -d' so the admin account can be created.

nodes.label: Upload Size Limits (MAX_* / *_MAX_SIZE Variables)
nodes.rationale: All upload-size variables are capped in practice by nginx: config/nginx/nginx.conf's client_max_body_size (default 20MB) must stay above any size variable raised in .env, otherwise nginx returns a 413 error before the request reaches Django.

nodes.label: Available Translations (en, fr, es, it, de)
nodes.norm_label: available translations (en, fr, es, it, de)
nodes.rationale: Shipped translations are mostly AI-produced and may be inaccurate; errors should be reported as GitHub issues. The language is switched dynamically from the gear wheel menu.

nodes.label: Docker Image Rebuild with COUSINS_MATTER_IMAGE Tag
nodes.norm_label: docker image rebuild with cousins_matter_image tag
nodes.rationale: Compiled translations only ship in a new image: 'docker build -t cousins-matter:<tag> .' then set COUSINS_MATTER_IMAGE to that tag in .env before restarting the container.

nodes.label: Add a New Translation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Any Latin LTR language can be added (RTL and non-Latin untested) by cloning the repo, generating and editing .po files, compiling them, rebuilding the Docker image, then opening a GitHub issue so the translation is added to the repository.

nodes.label: Genealogy family graph data model
nodes.rationale: The person detail page renders the whole family graph purely by navigating model relations in the template: person.child_of_family.partner1/partner2 for parents, person.get_partners() for unions, person.unions_as_p1/unions_as_p2.children for descendants. A union/family row linking partner1+partner2 and children is the single join structure; no extra view logic or service call is needed, which is why the template can stay thin.

nodes.label: HTMX live table search
nodes.rationale: The search input posts back to the same genealogy:person_list URL with hx-get on 'keyup changed delay:500ms' and swaps only #person-table-body via hx-target/hx-select. One endpoint serves both full page and fragment, avoiding a dedicated partial view; the 500ms debounce limits request volume while typing.

nodes.label: Chart.js statistics dashboards
nodes.rationale: Four Chart.js charts (gender distribution, births per decade, top first/last names) fed by JSON context (gender_data, top_first_names, top_last_names). Chart markup is wrapped in {% cache 3600 genealogy_statistics %} but the chart.js script tag and inline Chart init deliberately live OUTSIDE the cache block: the per-request CSP nonce must not be frozen inside the cached fragment (explicit comment in template).

nodes.label: Bulma-themed allauth element overrides
nodes.rationale: django-allauth ships element templates styled for Bootstrap; the repo overrides each element (button, button_group, fields, form, h1, p) plus layouts/base to emit Bulma classes (button is-primary is-centered, title is-3, buttons is-centered, table forms via crispy) and to inherit core/base.html, so every allauth/socialaccount page (login, signup, verification) keeps the site's Bulma/HTMX chrome instead of allauth's default look.

nodes.label: Shared address edit warning
nodes.rationale: An Address row is shared by several members (reverse relation object.address_of). The edit form shows an is-warning notification telling the user that editing an address modifies it for ALL members using it and to create a new address instead. This is a deliberate denormalization trade-off: address deduplication across household members is kept, at the cost of an edit-safety warning in the UI.

nodes.label: Write Test Env Composite Action
nodes.rationale: Writes one shared .env (COUSINS_MATTER_IMAGE, SECRET_KEY, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, Q_SYNC=True, ENVIRONMENT=docker-test, ADMIN_* vars) so every test job runs the container with an identical configuration; also prepends $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.local/bin to PATH.

nodes.label: Django UI Test Tagging
nodes.rationale: Same reusable workflow runs either `manage.py test --tag=ui` (after installing Playwright chromium inside the container) or `--exclude-tag=ui`, and uploads screenshots only on UI failure.

nodes.label: docker-compose.ci.yml Overlay
nodes.rationale: CI starts containers with the base docker-compose.yml plus a docker-compose.ci.yml overlay (--wait --wait-timeout 30) after clearing leftover volumes; screenshots dir is mounted for Playwright artifacts.

nodes.label: Docker Multiarch Build
nodes.rationale: QEMU + Buildx produce linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 images with registry-side build cache and an OCI index annotation; .dockerignore excludes **/tests/ from the production build.

nodes.label: GHCR Image Publishing
nodes.rationale: Image pushed to ghcr.io; tags come from release semver (type=semver,pattern={{version}}) on releases, branch ref on push, or sha otherwise. Push is gated on all test jobs passing and skipped for dependabot.

nodes.label: Production Image Health Verification
nodes.rationale: Downloads only manage_cousins_matter.py at the release tag, installs a minimal cm_test_install environment, rewrites .env for production, starts docker compose, asserts container health status and polls http://localhost:8000/ up to 10 times.

nodes.label: Python Lint & Security Toolchain
nodes.rationale: uv-driven pipeline: ruff format, ruff check --fix, bandit (pyproject.toml config), pip-audit, and mypy with migrations and .venv excluded.

nodes.label: Reusable Workflow Pipeline Pattern
nodes.rationale: One lint/build job builds a test image and shares it via artifact; four parallel test jobs (docker, install, s3, ui) must all pass before the multiarch push; production verification runs only for releases.

nodes.label: S3 / Cloudflare R2 Media Storage Integration
nodes.norm_label: s3 / cloudflare r2 media storage integration
nodes.rationale: Dedicated job appends MEDIA_STORAGE=storages.backends.s3.S3Storage plus MEDIA_STORAGE_OPTIONS (R2 access/secret keys, bucket, endpoint) to the shared .env to exercise object-storage media.

nodes.label: Vendored Front-end Assets Commit
nodes.rationale: Vendor scripts are refreshed via scripts/dev/vendor-update.sh only when package.json changed (detected by git diff against base ref or event.before), then committed as github-actions[bot] and pushed back to the branch so the image build uses committed assets.

nodes.label: Treasure Form Template
nodes.rationale: Includes the summernote rich editor with maxsize=settings.TROVE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_SIZE so treasure descriptions are rich text bounded by a settings value.

nodes.label: Trove Cave (Treasure List) Template
nodes.rationale: Groups treasures by category with paginated sections; owner-only edit/delete actions; delete is done inline via htmx (hx-post/hx-swap=delete) with a confirm dialog.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Deployment
nodes.rationale: v2 runs as at least 4 containers (web server, PostgreSQL database, redis, async tasks/qcluster) so docker compose is required; runs comfortably on 2 vCPUs / 2 GB RAM such as a Raspberry Pi 4/5 or small VPS.

nodes.label: MkDocs Documentation Site
nodes.rationale: The user manual is built and published as an MkDocs site; requirements.txt is the pip-compile lockfile pinning mkdocs, markdown-include and friends for Python 3.14.

nodes.label: OAuth/SSO Authentication
nodes.rationale: OAuth accounts are linked to Cousins Matter members by email address, so registration still requires a valid invitation; SOCIALACCOUNT_AUTO_SIGNUP defaults to False to require confirmation for security.

nodes.label: Protected Media Access
nodes.rationale: Treasure pictures, files and thumbnails are always served through the get_protected_media URL so access control is applied instead of linking media files directly.

nodes.label: Reverse Proxying (Nginx / Apache)
nodes.rationale: Nginx is the default proxy started by docker compose up (config/nginx/nginx.conf); /static and /media must still be served by some proxy even if the nginx service is removed.

nodes.label: Troves (Family Treasures) Feature
nodes.rationale: A place to put the focus on numeric family treasures: texts, music, videos.

nodes.label: Ajax modal form pattern (data-action / data-onsuccess contract)
nodes.norm_label: ajax modal form pattern (data-action / data-onsuccess contract)
nodes.rationale: Generic create/update/delete modals driven purely by button data attributes (data-target, data-action, data-form, data-onsuccess, data-init-function, data-no-warning, data-kind) so views return fragments and one JS handler in core.js covers all apps; confirm-delete-modal reuses the htmx modal base and adds typed confirmation (expected_value) plus hx-swap=delete removal.

nodes.label: Bulma CSS + MDI icons (vendored)
nodes.rationale: Bulma and Material Design Icons are vendored under core/static/core/vendor rather than pulled from a CDN, keeping the self-hosted install CSP-safe and offline-capable.

nodes.label: Chat WebSocket JSON Action Protocol
nodes.rationale: Client connects to ws(s)://host/chat/ws/<room_slug> and exchanges JSON actions: create_chat_message, update_chat_message, delete_chat_message, read_status_update, error; server replies with pre-rendered message HTML.

nodes.label: cm_tags templatetag library (icon, title, navbar_item, navbar_link, paginate, inline_css, featured)
nodes.norm_label: cm_tags templatetag library (icon, title, navbar_item, navbar_link, paginate, inline_css, featured)
nodes.rationale: Templates stay dumb by pushing markup generation into cm_tags inclusion/simple tags (core/templatetags/cm_tags.py): icon, title, navbar_item/navbar_link (inclusion tags rendering navbar_item.html/navbar_link.html), paginate (renders paginate_template.html), inline_css, featured filter. Verified by reading cm_tags.py registers at lines 129, 171, 182, 204, 215.

nodes.label: CSP nonce handling for inline scripts/styles
nodes.norm_label: csp nonce handling for inline scripts/styles
nodes.rationale: CSP style-src/script-src forbid inline code, so every inline <script>/<style> carries nonce={{ csp_nonce }} and htmx.config.inlineStyleNonce is set so htmx-injected indicator styles pass; email templates are excluded because they never traverse CSP middleware.

nodes.label: CSP-safe htmx Escape-key Pattern
nodes.rationale: hx-vals="js:..." would require unsafe-eval; instead a nonced script fills a hidden `trigger` input and submits the room-edit form on Escape, keeping CSP strict.

nodes.label: django-flatpages driven content (home/about pages)
nodes.rationale: Home page content and about/footer pages are flat pages resolved per language prefix, letting family admins edit content through pages-edit instead of redeploying templates.

nodes.label: django-template-partials {% partialdef %}
nodes.rationale: Reusable inline partials (room_name_display, room_edit_form, message_div, member_search_results, image-gallery, subcategories) let the same markup render server-side and be swapped by htmx.

nodes.label: Per-tenant feature flags (featured filter)
nodes.rationale: Nav entries and home widgets are gated by 'show_*'|featured (FEATURES_FLAGS / TenantSettings in cm_tags._feature_flags), letting one codebase serve many families with different enabled apps.

nodes.label: htmx partial-swap integration
nodes.rationale: Design intent: server-rendered HTML fragments swapped by htmx (hx-get/hx-post/hx-target/hx-swap) instead of a JS SPA; CSRF injected globally via hx-headers on <body>; re-init hooks on htmx:load / htmx:afterOnLoad so widgets survive swaps.

nodes.label: jQuery dependency
nodes.rationale: jQuery is kept only because the widget plugins (bulma-calendar, summernote, select2) require it; a jQuery 4 compatibility shim (jQuery.type/jQuery.now) is injected before summernote 0.9 loads and can be dropped when summernote ships jQuery-4 support.

nodes.label: Private Chat Read Receipts
nodes.rationale: Only private rooms render a read-receipt span (read / partially / sent via mdi-check icons); the read_status_update socket action live-updates only the sender's own messages.

nodes.label: Protected Media Serving
nodes.rationale: Ad photos (thumbnail and fullscreen) are resolved through the get_protected_media url so access control is applied; images are never linked directly.

nodes.label: settings exposed in template context
nodes.rationale: Per-instance branding and behavior (DARK_MODE, SITE_LOGO, SITE_FOOTER, SITE_COPYRIGHT, PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL theme.css, AUTHENTICATED/UNAUTHENTICATED_HOME_PAGE, MULTI_TENANT_ENABLED, DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE) are read via {{ settings.* }} so deployments customize without code changes.
